operations.title: Grothendieck six-point exceptional readout duality-gate packet
Grothendieck six-point exceptional readout duality-gate checker
Grothendieck six-point exceptional readout duality-gate result
Six-point exceptional coefficient covariance does not determine a source-derived physical pairing
operations.body: The rank-eight exceptional shift module's reflection covariance and trivial cyclic holonomy constrain only the coefficient variance. A formal contragredient partner always produces a tautological invariant evaluation pairing and therefore supplies no physical evidence. The same exact covariance type admits a trivial partner for which all covariant pairings have rank at most four, a deficit of four from a perfect pairing. Hence coefficient covariance cannot determine Gamma_source or physical descent. Required new source data are a global cycle module, its generator actions, a normalized pairing matrix, and a physical rank criterion. The ordinary all-arity disk-period abelianization is unaffected.

operations.title: Rank-eight duality underdetermination falsifier for the six-point exceptional readout
Grothendieck reports the exact six-point exceptional duality underdetermination to Nima
operations.body: Six-point exceptional duality gate complete. Coefficient covariance alone cannot determine the physical readout. For any coefficient representation R_N, the formal contragredient partner R_N^{-T} with evaluation P=I gives a tautological perfect invariant pairing, so that construction is not source or physical evidence. An exact rank-eight dihedral control with the same covariance type also admits a trivial partner for which every covariant pairing has rank at most 4, giving rank deficit 4. The source must provide Gamma_source, its action matrices for the same generators, a normalized pairing P, and a physical rank criterion; only then test D_g=R_N(g)^T P R_Gamma(g)-P and the induced commutator action. The ordinary all-arity disk-period theorem is unaffected.
